reviews.title: Great office chair!
reviews.body: This chair is great. I almost exclusively sit cross legged, and I simply love how the arms fold down. I've got cats, and they always want to sit with me when I'm working - being able to flatten out the arms means more space for them and less awkward positioning for me trying to accommodate them. The color is great, and the fabric is soft and easy to clean (I vacuum when it needs refreshing). It looks great with my black and white desk setup and it fits perfectly under my desk. Putting it together was also pretty easy - just make sure you really confirm the sides you're setting up, I definitely had to take it apart to get it right. There is essentially no lumbar support, so don't expect that going in. But if you're comfortable cross legged, this is a great chair for that.

features: Designed for Sitting Cross-Legged: This criss cross office chair features flip-up armrests that fold flat (90°-180° adjustable for petite women 5'0"-5'6"). Lift one or both armrests to create the space you need to sit criss cross, tailor-style, or with one leg tucked. Unlike bulky ergonomic chairs, this small desk chair for women gives you the freedom to change positions throughout the day.

Perfect for Petite Frames and Small Spaces: This small office chair is proportioned for users 5'0" to 5'6" and tight spaces like dorm rooms, small apartments, or bedroom corners. The seat height (16.7"-20.5") and backrest are sized for smaller frames, so you won't feel like you're sitting in an oversized executive chair. If you're searching for a "chair for petite women," this cross legged desk chair is your match.

Soft Corduroy That Stands Up to Pets: Wrapped in textured corduroy fabric, this green desk chair for bedroom is as durable as it is cozy. The material resists scratches from curious cats and small dogs, and it's easy to spot-clean with a damp cloth. Unlike velvet or mesh, corduroy offers a warm, vintage look that hides everyday wear. A genuine "pet friendly office chair" for animal lovers who don't want to sacrifice style.

Just-Right Recline for Leisurely Sitting: This cross legged chair for adults lets you lean back between 90° and 105° for a more relaxed posture—great for reading, scrolling, or casual video calls. Lock it at 90° when you need stability for makeup or typing. Note: This is a comfortable home office chair for short women, not an 8-hour work marathon chair. Designed for the way you actually live.

Available in 4 Aesthetic Colors: Choose from soft pink (best-selling for bedroom decor), classic white (for a clean minimalist look), light green (for a fresh calming vibe), and deep green (for a rich vintage statement). The corduroy texture adds depth to any color, making this cute computer chair a standout piece in your space. Note: Actual color may vary slightly due to lighting and display settings.
